collision_policy: Every nonzero alpha counts, zero new/old and text/music contacts, zero lyric/lyric contacts; strictly positive Euclidean ink-center clearance; fail closed without moving old layers.
complete_scope: Six inventoried lyric continuation marks, not independently complete source or performance-ready score
geometry: Reuse GT14B extender helper unchanged: 2px horizontal stroke, source bbox x/width, top y=floor((source_top+source_bottom-1)/2)+frozen paired-row displacement. New GT14C boxes are dark-support measurements, not original-ink ownership.
semantic_policy: Unchanged V3 full guards with frozen source and targets; exact existing note/tie and lyric signatures. No new syllables/chords/events.
understood_as: Apply explicit owner approval in a separate layer; add only three new strokes to frozen GT14B canvases, preserve all old pixels and original candidate records.
